title: Developer roster
description: Questionnaire section 3b, held as a sidecar beside the completed questionnaire in completed_qs/ rather than inside the questionnaire itself. The questionnaire schema sets additionalProperties:false throughout and its example copy is committed; a roster is personal data and must not be able to reach either. See completed_qs/README.md.

tenant.description: Repeated from the questionnaire so the roster names the tenant it grants access to. derive-roster.py refuses to proceed unless these three match the questionnaire exactly -- a roster applied to the wrong tenant grants the wrong people access to real accounts, and nothing downstream would question it.

developers.description: One entry per person. An empty list is legal: section 3b is marked Dev, not Vest, so a tenant can be vested before its roster is known.

environments.description: Which of the tenant's vested environments this person reaches. Checked against the questionnaire's UAT election -- uat here with uat_required false is an error, not a silently ignored line.

user_name.description: Identity Center sign-in name, when it is not the email. Points at an EXISTING directory entry; without it a lookup by email finds nothing and a second identity is created for the same human. Same semantics as the fourth field in config/identity.env.

console_access.description: Questionnaire 3.7. False means pipeline-only: recorded, and currently advisory. The permission sets are not yet split on it -- B-131.

exception.description: Questionnaire 3b: 'If somebody needs an exception, tell us who and why rather than working around it.' Free text, required by derive-roster.py for anyone reaching prod.
